figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS feb_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY feb_orders DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;

parts.label: 取数
parts.note: 结果表最终显示 2 列：customer_id、feb_orders。

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01'
parts.note: 数据来自 表 customers、表 orders，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 分组
parts.note: 按 c.customer_id 把行归入各个分组。

parts.label: 排序
parts.sql: ORDER BY feb_orders DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;
parts.note: 按 feb_orders DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC 排列结果。

steps.label: FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
steps.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS feb_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id

steps.label: ORDER BY feb_orders DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;
steps.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS feb_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY feb_orders DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;

figures.title: 日期条件写在 ON 里的左连接
figures.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.id, o.customer_id, o.order_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01'
figures.conclusion: 日期条件写在 ON 里，只限制哪些订单可以和客户配对；没有符合订单的客户仍然保留。
